doc.title: Germaine Bazzle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006

title: Future plans for jazz festivals
summary: With a lighter teaching load she would like to play a jazz festival each month.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Any new things coming down the pike for you?

Not that I know of. Not that I know of. I’m hoping — there are some things that I’d like to do now that my teaching load has gotten smaller I have a little bit more freedom now to do things. And I’d like to do more jazz festivals. I’d like to go different places. I’m not talking about 90 days anywhere. You know, but go to someplace, do a jazz festival, eat and go back home. Go somewhere else. Once a month maybe. You know a jazz fest a month wouldn’t kill me. I still would be able to do it and still work with my kids.
